name: Filter
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Filter items based on a condition. If the item meets the condition, the Filter node passes it on to the next node in the Filter node output. If the item doesn't meet the condition, the Filter node omits the item from its output

parameters.name: Combining conditions
parameters.description: You can choose to keep items:

parameters.name: Ignore Case
parameters.description: Whether to ignore letter case (turned on) or be case sensitive (turned off)

parameters.name: Less Strict Type Validation
parameters.description: Whether you want n8n to attempt to convert value types based on the operator you choose (turned on) or not (turned off). Turn this on when facing a "wrong type:" error in your node

parameters.name: looseTypeValidation
parameters.description: If the type of an expression doesn't match the type of the comparison, n8n will try to cast the expression to the required type. E.g. for booleans "false" or 0 will be cast to false

options.name: ignoreCase
options.description: Whether to ignore letter case when evaluating conditions

options.name: looseTypeValidation
options.description: If the type of an expression doesn't match the type of the comparison, n8n will try to cast the expression to the required type. E.g. for booleans <code>"false"
